text:
anita: Planning to enable argo-nova-7b-v2 in the model catalog tonight during the 22:00 UTC change window. Need handshake for tiering and an explicit rollback/backstop plan. Pinlist will include org/test-apps first.

deploybot: deploybot: scheduled catalog enable for 2024-05-05 22:00 UTC. Preflight hooks queued. Will post preflight results. :robot_face:

cheng: Can we lock the fallback ordering to prefer quantv1 then quant-legacy then CPU? Last time CPU fallback spiked timeouts.

srijan: +1 on ordering. Also recommend stepped traffic ramp: 10 -> 25 -> 50 -> 100% with metric gates at each step (p50/p95 latency, error_rate, cost_per_token).

anita: Adding to rollout config now:```
model: argo-nova-7b-v2
ramp_percent: [10,25,50,100]
fallback_priority: [argo-nova-7b-quantv1, argo-nova-7b-quant-legacy, cpu-small]
pin_targets: [org/test-apps]
rollback_policy: latency_increase>30% OR err_rate>2% sustained 3m -> auto-rollback
```

ops_lead: Ops ack. We'll watch deploybot alerts and tracer spikes. Ensure tracing hooks are on for first 30m. Set a manual hold if downstream services show degradation.

maya: I'm running a small eval harness against our canary prompt set now, will post diffs in ~45m.

deploybot: deploybot: preflight complete — warmup on 6 hosts, KV cache primed, memory checks passed. No failed checks. Ready to proceed.

anita: Start at 22:00. @cheng @srijan please be on call for the first 30m. If anything odd, ping #eng-sre and escalate.

cheng: On call. Runbooks open, slack ping path verified.

srijan: Watching telemetry and prepared to trigger rollback if thresholds breached.

deploybot: deploybot: enable executed at 22:00 UTC. Traffic routing set to new variant; beginning ramp to 10%.

maya: Quick sanity: initial eval diffs look fine. p95 latency up from 120ms -> 140ms but within our threshold. No hallucination pattern changes on sample set.

ops_lead: Hold 10m then advance to 25% if no alerts — agreed. All teams acknowledge.

anita: Advancing to 25% now. @deploybot continue ramp sequence per config.

deploybot: deploybot: ramped to 25% at 22:12 UTC. No alerts fired.

srijan: All green on metrics so far, continuing to watch.

anita: Reminder: if we roll back, revert pin to argo-nova-7b-stable and record rollback reason in release notes + incident channel.

maya: Will prepare release note snippet and post it to #release-notes.

anita: Thanks all — will keep this thread updated.
